title: AICP reputation log configuration
description: Body of GET /.well-known/aicp-log (§6.4.11). This URL is log_id. Every URL and URL template MUST be https and same-origin with the issuer.

sth_publish_interval_seconds.description: Issuers MUST publish an STH at least this often. Re-signing an unchanged tree is allowed.

entry_url_template.description: MUST accept a tree_size query parameter, for example ?tree_size={tree_size}.

subject_url_template.description: MUST accept a tree_size query parameter.

consistency_url_template.description: MUST accept first, second, and tree_size query parameters.
